title: H1: enforce Kernel lease admission for worktree grants
agent_hint: Base 9b92c936. Kernel.claim in src/pmk/api.py does no admission validation: claim(worktree=<repo root>) succeeds, and a worktree grant with no pid/expires_at succeeds while project state is NEW/PAUSED. Add Kernel-side validation for worktree-bearing grants: reject a path resolving to the repo root with invalid_worktree, and reject a grant lacking pid or expires_at when project_state() != RUNNING with lease_incomplete; the reason must be visible in the KernelError details and a LEASE_REFUSED event. Add an explicit expires_at argument if needed for the legitimate grant. Add a legitimate pid + future expires_at grant while NEW/PAUSED and a RUNNING grant. Keep non-worktree claims used by tests/pmk/test_tasks.py working; if you broaden the gate, update their setup in scope rather than weakening the check. Do not retroactively alter historical leases. Add tests/pmk/test_lease_admission.py; run the listed oracles.
